categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Wafer Works Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor silicon epitaxial wafers. The company specializes in integrated manufacturing processes from crystal growth, substrate forming to epitaxial growth, producing high-quality silicon epitaxial wafers mainly used in power devices and analog chips across automotive, industrial, communication, and office sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies including magnetic field Czochralski crystal growth, multi-element doping, crystal defect control, ultra-low resistivity crystal growth, single-wafer polishing, surface cleanliness treatment, nano-morphology control, and epitaxial growth temperature control. It employs integrated production methods covering crystal growth, substrate forming, and epitaxial growth, supported by advanced manufacturing systems like SAP, MES, and SPC for quality control and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global semiconductor manufacturers such as TSMC, Hua Hong Group, On Semiconductor, Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, and Analog Devices. The end markets served are primarily semiconductor foundries and IDM companies producing power devices, analog chips, CMOS image sensors, and power management ICs, with applications in automotive, industrial, communications, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shanghai, Zhengzhou, and Yangzhou. Its customer base spans North America, Europe, and other Asian countries, reflecting a global market reach. The majority of sales revenue is generated from overseas markets, accounting for approximately 85% of total sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Wafer Works operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a manufacturer of silicon epitaxial wafers, a critical raw material for semiconductor device fabrication. It supplies wafers to downstream semiconductor foundries and IDM manufacturers but does not engage in chip design or packaging.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on advancing 8-inch and 12-inch silicon epitaxial wafer technologies, emphasizing power devices and analog chip applications aligned with the 'beyond Moore's Law' trend. R&D priorities include developing high-performance CIS wafers, PMIC wafers, automotive-grade IGBT wafers, and AI-enabled semiconductor materials. It invests heavily in integrated epitaxial wafer production and capacity expansion, aiming to enhance domestic substitution and technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of semiconductor silicon epitaxial wafers to foundries and IDM customers. The company employs both direct sales and distributor sales models, with pricing based on product specifications and customer contracts. It also earns income from processing services related to wafer manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor silicon wafer market is dominated by international leaders such as Shin-Etsu Chemical, Sumco Corporation, GlobalWafers, Siltronic AG, and SK Siltron. Shanghai Wafer Works is one of the few Chinese companies with integrated epitaxial wafer production capabilities, positioning itself as a leading domestic supplier with growing international recognition and a focus on high-end 12-inch wafer technologies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.11 billion, a 17.76% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 120.78 million, down 51.07%. Total assets reached RMB 4.57 billion, up 24.44%, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 4.14 billion, up 48.49%, reflecting capital raised from its 2024 IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of about 9% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Wafer Works emphasizes its integrated production capability from crystal growth to epitaxial wafer manufacturing, enabling superior quality control and customization to meet diverse customer needs. Its advanced core technologies yield wafers with high flatness, uniformity, low defect density, and tailored doping profiles, supporting high-performance power and analog semiconductor devices. The company’s focus on domestic substitution and collaboration with leading global semiconductor firms enhances its competitive edge.
